13. 设 \(f(x,y)\) 可微, \(p(x,y), p_0(x_0,y_0)\) 为曲面 \(z=f(x,y)\) 上的点, 则 ( ).
A. \[\lim_{p\to p_0} \frac{f(p)+\left[f(p_0)-\operatorname{grad}f\big|_{p_0}\circ \overrightarrow{p_0 p}\right]}{\left|\overrightarrow{p_0 p}\right|}=0\]
B. \[\lim_{p\to p_0} \frac{f(p)-\left[f(p_0)-\operatorname{grad}f\big|_{p_0}\cdot \overrightarrow{p_0 p}\right]}{\left|\overrightarrow{p_0 p}\right|}=0\]
C. \[\lim_{p\to p_0} \frac{f(p)+\left[f(p_0)+\operatorname{grad}f\big|_{p_0}\cdot \overrightarrow{p_0 p}\right]}{\left|\overrightarrow{p_0 p}\right|}=0\]
D. \[\lim_{p\to p_0} \frac{f(p)-\left[f(p_0)+\operatorname{grad}f\big|_{p_0}\cdot \overrightarrow{p_0 p}^2\right]}{\left|\overrightarrow{p_0 p}\right|}=0\]
